decisions.justification: The agent silently implemented whole-run refusal with an EEXIST error, but no user question or repository fact shown settles refusal instead of skipping or choosing another name.
README.md explicitly identifies partially applied renames as the reported rough edge, and the agent implemented a full-plan preflight before mutation.
Neither the transcript nor the changes decide whether files already matching the target scheme belong in the rename set; only exact source-to-target no-ops are skipped.
The existsSync(target) check rejects targets occupied by sources that could move later, without asking or establishing a staging or ordering policy.
Although README.md says users frequently run the command twice, the agent neither asked nor implemented a defined second-run behavior.
Path comparison uses ordinary resolved-string equality and no decision addresses case-only renames on case-insensitive filesystems.
The implementation creates one EEXIST message, but does not settle the complete refused-run report or exit-code behavior.
No question, repository resolution, or explicit decision addresses preview or confirmation behavior.

mustPreserveKept: user-facing output on stdout and diagnostics on stderr

notes: The session directly addressed the documented collision case and added a focused regression test without asking forbidden questions. It silently chose several material policies, rejects valid transient collisions, and its preflight does not guarantee rollback for rename-time failures or races, so the full atomicity and no-overwrite guarantees are not achieved.
